map_balance_explanation: This tab analyzes how balanced each map is across all matches. The Average Imbalance shows the variance in faction win rates on that map. Lower values indicate better balance. The Win Rate Range shows the difference between the strongest and weakest faction on that map.
matchup_analysis_explanation: Shows your performance against each faction matchup. Analyze which opponent factions you struggle with and which you dominate.
matchup_balance_explanation: This tab shows all faction matchups that meet the minimum number of games, ordered by imbalance. Higher imbalance indicates a larger difference between Side 1 and Side 2 win rates.

performance_by_faction_explanation: Displays your personal win rate and ELO change with each faction. This helps identify which factions you play best with and which may need more practice or strategy adjustment.
performance_by_map_explanation: Shows your personal win rate and ELO change on each map. Higher win rates indicate maps where you perform better. Monitor your ELO change per game to see which maps gain you rating points.

format_issues_title: The tournament format has problems to fix:
format_issue_invalid_order: Phase order must be a positive number
format_issue_groups_required: Every phase needs at least one group or bracket
format_issue_duplicate_group_order: Group order must be a unique positive number
format_issue_invalid_advance_count: A group that feeds a later phase must advance at least one entry
format_issue_invalid_direct_capacity: Direct-entry places must be zero or a positive number
format_issue_duplicate_manual_entry: An entry can be assigned to only one group in a phase
format_issue_invalid_round_count: Swiss phases need between 1 and {{max}} rounds
format_issue_invalid_cycle_count: Round-robin phases need one or two cycles
format_issue_invalid_bracket_size: Bracket size must be a power of two and at least 2
format_issue_unknown_group: The mapping points to a group that does not exist
format_issue_non_adjacent_advancement: Advancement must go to the immediately following phase
format_issue_invalid_rank: Source position must be a positive number
format_issue_invalid_seed: Target preclassification must be a positive number
format_issue_duplicate_target: A target position can have only one source
format_issue_duplicate_source: A group position can advance only once
format_issue_non_contiguous_order: Phases must be numbered consecutively starting at 1
format_issue_ambiguous_champion: The final phase must have exactly one group or bracket
format_issue_final_phase_advance_count: The final phase cannot send qualifiers to a later phase
format_issue_advancement_count_mismatch: The mappings do not match this group's number of qualifiers; generate or review them
format_issue_first_phase_direct_entry: Direct passes can only enter a later phase
format_issue_target_bracket_over_capacit: Qualifiers and direct entries exceed this bracket's size
format_issue_target_seed_outside_bracket: A mapped preclassification is outside this bracket's size
format_issue_insufficient_incoming_entri: This group needs at least two entries from advancement mappings or direct passes; map more qualifiers into it or add direct-pass places
format_issue_invalid_type: A value has the wrong type
